title: Stationary phase with Cauchy singularity. A critical point of signature $(+,-)$
summary: Asymptotic expressions for an integral appearing in the solution of a d-bar problem are presented. The integral is a solid Cauchy transform of a function with a rapidly oscillating phase with a small parameter $h$, $0<h\ll 1$. Whereas standard steepest descent approaches can be applied to the case where the stationary points of the phase $ω_{k}$, $k=1,\ldots, N$ are far from the singularity $ζ$ of the integrand, a polarization approach is proposed for the case that $|ζ-ω_{k}|<\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{h})$ for some $k$. In this case the problem is studied in $\mathbb{C}^{2}$…
